svg.aria-label: Dinordle taxonomic tree: a horizontal rectangular cladogram in five states — a fresh round holding only Dinosauria, the marks key, a mid-round descent from Dinosauria to Saltasaurinae where each ruled-out branch is a red-ringed node with the guess that ruled it out hanging below it as a red-ringed leaf one column further right, the same diagram inside a 360 pixel scroll container with the trunk pinned at the left edge, and the solved round descending twenty nodes to Saltasaurus
svg.text: One row per label · depth runs left to right · a ruled-out branch and the guess inside it are ringed
REQ-004 · REQ-005 — one row, and nothing below it
MID-ROUND · 6 OF 8 GUESSES · CLOSEST RELATIVE 18 NODES DOWN
REQ-001 · REQ-002 · REQ-003 — the deep case, not a flattering one
measured: 29 rows · widest row 535 px · trunk indent 17 × 16 px = 272 px
SOLVED · DEPTH 20 — THE DEEPEST LINEAGE THE SNAPSHOT HOLDS
REQ-005 · UX-001 — no label wraps, so no connector can break
measured: 31 rows · widest row 520 px — still wider than the 512 px column basis, so the pane scrolls
UX-001 — the diagram scrolls, the trunk stays pinned
the two ringed columns continue past the right edge
trunk pinned · nothing wraps · no word is clipped
WHAT IS DRAWN, AND BY WHAT
one aria-hidden <svg>, drawn from (row, depth) only
the <ol>/<li> the screen ships, positioned on its row
21 px, fixed — a label can never wrap
16 px — the shortest dashed lead is one indent
3 on, 2 off, 1.2 px stroke — 3 marks per 16 px
(deepest depth + 1) × 16 px — every branch ends there
one indent further right — a leaf inside that branch
